Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear asks. Attached is an itemized workbook (compliance-pricing-v3.xlsx) with three packaging options and our recommendation. Executive summary below:

1) Modular (flex) — pay-as-you-go recurring pricing per feature
   - Audit logs: $0.015/GB-month, retention tiers 30/90/365 days listed on tab ‘AuditLog’
   - KMS (software-managed keys): $1,200/month per region
   - HSM (FIPS 140-2): $3,500/month per HSM seat + one-time provisioning fee
   - Implementation: $18k one-time (covers HSM provisioning, audit ingest pipeline, and residency cutover)

2) Bundled (pilot-friendly) — pilot credits + capped onboarding
   - We can offer up to a $12k pilot credit against the one-time implementation fee for trials under 6 months
   - For customers that commit to 12 months, implementation can be amortized as a monthly recurring credit (we can spread the $18k as $1,500/mo credit applied across the first 12 invoices)

3) Enterprise (SLA + residency) — committed capacity and residency guarantees
   - Residency per-region surcharge: $2,000/month (adds reserved compute + legal attestation)
   - HSM seat discount: up to 20% for multi-seat commitments or annual prepay

Our ask: for Orchid’s PO path, we recommend one of two operational approaches: (A) accept the $12k pilot credit and pay remaining implementation at SOW sign; or (B) sign a 12-month commit and let us amortize the implementation fee across invoices. Either approach is compatible with Net30 invoicing.

I’ve copied Laura and Ben for commercial approval of a pilot concession if you prefer the credit route. I’ll hold until EOD tomorrow for preference and can share a draft SOW immediately.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(priyom_das@redwood.com)
